verdict.rationale: Gemini CLI is itself an AI agent. It documents task delegation: querying and editing large codebases, debugging in natural language, automating operational tasks like PR queries and rebases, and on-demand delegation by mentioning @gemini-cli in GitHub issues and PRs. Hands-on reports are mixed: some users praise its large-codebase navigation and code reviews, while others describe error loops, failed edits, and a destructive file-move incident that cast doubt on reliability rather than on whether the capability exists. Missing for 10: consistent independent corroboration of reliable multi-step task execution, and documentation of planning or safe-execution controls for delegated tasks.
